reviewed_hunks.quote: A 2026-11-08 verbal-fluency and face-name search kept both candidates out of scope (ADR-053). No eligible verbal-fluency training meta-analysis was found, and open-ended generation cannot be scored deterministically. Kelly et al. 2014 (PMID 24607830; 31 RCTs, 1,806 cognitive-training participants) reported face-name recall (p=0.02) and paired associates (p=0.001) gains versus no intervention, but it is not an active-control face-name meta-analysis and a validated face stimulus set would need privacy and consent handling. The Paired Associates mnemonic hint was also surfaced in the pre-test briefing as an optional Strategy tip.
